value.body:
scratch/design.md item 17 is accepted and supersedes the constructor functions: TrainingJob and EvalJob are subclasses of Job written directly in the experiment file (no training_job/eval_job functions). Job identity, stored and sent forms must not change; a typed job keeps its config type so model_copy makes a correct variant; the constructors' checks still fail where the job is written. Read item 17 in full before planning.
